_comment: Accepted mismatches of the integrationtest part (TiDB v8.5.8 tests/integrationtest; lines are stable), keyed by 'test:line'. Only tidb-rs bugs ('class': 'bug', with the 'issue' tracking it) and answers whose row order the test does not fix ('class': 'nondeterministic') belong here, each with a one-line 'reason'; a mismatch the harness causes is fixed in tools/ab instead. report.py counts listed mismatches as known, makes any other mismatch RED, and asks to remove an entry whose statement ran on tidb-rs without mismatching.
